signature: SUBROUTINE ZHPGV( ITYPE, JOBZ, UPLO, N, AP, BP, W, Z, LDZ, WORK,

params.name: itype
params.reference:
Specifies the problem type to be solved:

-   `= 1`: $A \, x = (\lambda ) \, B \, x$
-   `= 2`: $A \, B \, x = (\lambda ) \, x$
-   `= 3`: $B \, A \, x = (\lambda ) \, x$

params.name: jobz
params.reference:
-   `= 'N'`: Compute eigenvalues only;
-   `= 'V'`: Compute eigenvalues and eigenvectors.

params.name: uplo
params.reference:
-   `= 'U'`: Upper triangles of A and B are stored;
-   `= 'L'`: Lower triangles of A and B are stored.

params.name: N
params.reference: The order of the matrices A and B. $N \ge 0$.

params.name: AP
params.reference:
On entry, the upper or lower triangle of the Hermitian matrix A, packed columnwise in a linear array. The j-th column of A is stored in the array `AP` as follows: if `UPLO = 'U'`, `AP(i + (j-1)*j/2) = A(i,j)` for $1 \le i \le j$; if `UPLO = 'L'`, `AP(i + (j-1)*(2*n-j)/2) = A(i,j)` for $j \le i \le n$.

On exit, the contents of `AP` are destroyed.

params.name: BP
params.reference:
On entry, the upper or lower triangle of the Hermitian matrix B, packed columnwise in a linear array. The j-th column of B is stored in the array `BP` as follows: if `UPLO = 'U'`, `BP(i + (j-1)*j/2) = B(i,j)` for $1 \le i \le j$; if `UPLO = 'L'`, `BP(i + (j-1)*(2*n-j)/2) = B(i,j)` for $j \le i \le n$.

On exit, the triangular factor U or L from the Cholesky factorization $B = U^H \, U$ or $B = L \, L^H$, in the same storage format as B.

params.name: w
params.reference: If `INFO = 0`, the eigenvalues in ascending order.

params.name: Z
params.reference: If `JOBZ = 'V'`, then if `INFO = 0`, Z contains the matrix Z of eigenvectors. The eigenvectors are normalized as follows: if `ITYPE = 1` or 2, $Z^H \, B \, Z = I$; if `ITYPE = 3`, $Z^H \, \operatorname{inv}(B) \, Z = I$. If `JOBZ = 'N'`, then Z is not referenced.

params.name: ldz
params.reference: The leading dimension of the array Z. $\mathrm{LDZ} \ge 1$, and if `JOBZ = 'V'`, $\mathrm{LDZ} \ge \max (1,N)$.

params.name: info
params.reference:
-   `= 0`: successful exit
-   `< 0`: if `INFO = -i`, the i-th argument had an illegal value
-   `> 0`: ZPPTRF or ZHPEV returned an error code: \<= N:  if `INFO = i`, ZHPEV failed to converge; i off-diagonal elements of an intermediate tridiagonal form did not convergeto zero;
-   `> N`: if $\mathrm{INFO} = N + i$, for $1 \le i \le n$, then the leading principal minor of order i of B is not positive. The factorization of B could not be completed and no eigenvalues or eigenvectors were computed.
